ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions dominate the distal lobes. A dark black/grey anchor-shaped region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. Transition zones show fine-grained grey mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present across the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks varies between 4-12 pixels, creating a jagged silhouette against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve meeting a convex anterior edge at sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible cluster of roughly 15-20 dark circular spots on the left white lobe and 8-12 similar circular spots on the right white lobe, likely representing previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent horizontal dark linear mark is visible on the upper section of the left lobe white region; faint diagonal grey rake marks are visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, high-intensity white calcified barnacle remnants are visible along the distal-most tips and sparsely along the serrated trailing edge.
